To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) The universal information of a large class of black holes could be encoded in the thermodynamic laws of both outer (O) and inner (I) horizons; (ii) The dual CFTs of the black hole are determined by the thermodynamics laws; (iii) Different dual pictures of the same black hole could be read from different thermodynamics laws.

the universal information, including the central charge, temperature and the number of degrees of freedom, of the dual CTF is fully encoded in a set of thermodynamic laws of both outer (event) and inner horizons of the black hole.
the thermodynamics of both the outer and inner horisons of the black hole can be used to determine the dual CFT.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of black hole thermodynamics and the holographic dual CFT.
a novel method of studying the black-hole/CFT correspondence, which is based on the thermodynamics laws.

the following three topics: (i) We show that the thermodynamics laws for the outer and inner horizon, which is a universal property for the black hole, can be used to determine the universal information in the dual CFT; (ii) We show that a black hole can have more than one holographic description with respect to different perturbations.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, for the large class of black holes under investigation, the dual CFT is the outer horizon of a black hole.
the thermodynamics of the black hole, in a sense, is the thermodynamics of its dual CFT.
the inner horizon is the holographic screen of the black hole.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the inner horizon of a black hole is a holographic image of a 2D conformal field theory.
the inner horizon, which has been long ignored, should be treated equally with the outer horizon.
the inner horizon is as important as the outer horizon in understanding the holographic description of black hole.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, for the black holes in the large N limit, the inner horizon is not only the holographic boundary of the outer horizon, but also the holographic boundary for the whole black hole.
the thermodynamic description of black holes is not only an efficient tool for understanding the holographic description, but also a powerful tool for understanding the black hole physics itself.
the thermodynamic description of the black-hole/CFT correspondence could provide us with a new perspective to study the holographic duality.
